page.layout: One page of text. Top: a running head "SYLVÆ." with page number 4 at the top right; below it a four-line verse block (full width). Then a rule, then a large title block "IN STRABONIS GEOGRAPHICOS LIBROS..." with a centred subtitle line "Sylua VI.", then the body in a single column of verse-like lines with a drop cap T. Signature "A 4" at the bottom right.

main_text.p: Hunc igitur Ṡatem Buchananum Scottia iactes Vna tuum, felix tantis natalibus Ṡna. Macte quoque ingenij tanta Ṡirtute, Georgi, Æternum Ꝭ Latij spoliis ornatús optimis, Inuidiáque omni maior, Buchanane, triumpha.
main_text.head: IN STRABONIS GEOGRAPHICOS LIBROS ab Isaaco Casaubono felicissimè & eruditissimè emendatos Th.Bezæ Carmen.
Sylua VI.
main_text.p: TEr senos agerem Ṡita quum feruidus annos, Visendique orbis pulchro succensus amore: Hoc duce fretus ego, quo nullus certius Ṡno Monstrauit mundo Ṡisendū quidquid in omni, Et maria Ꝭ terras, Hispanus orsus ab oris, Impiger inspexi, gelidam qua se Ṡsque sub Arcto, Porrigit Europa, Ꝭ Tanais se littore claudens, Inde petit Ṡariis sinuosum anfractibus Austrum, Limitis Eoi quà seruat barbarus oras (perbus, Sauromata, inde truces Thraces, Macedoȝsu- Et qua Cycladibus collisum funditur æquor Ægeum, Euripique diu latrantibus Ṡndis Infractum, doctas Ṡersus deflectit Athenas: Et bimaris tandem elapsum de faucibus Isthmi, Hinc Malea, hinc contra Minoia littora pulsat, Ionio exceptum, quo tota infraque supraque A 4

page.notes: Several words in the verse are doubtful, especially the Greek-looking and long-s forms; the drop cap T is joined to "Erfenos". The title and body partly obscured by stains; the line "Macedoȝsu-" is uncertain. Dropped and dubious letters are marked with [?] where not certain.
